objective: Create a truly separately installable Expo Android native QA staging app with a unique Android package, runtime and OTA channel, while keeping the previous staging-user APK/runtime 1.3.2, production app/runtime 1.3.2, and both published OTA channels unchanged. Build only after real native GIF, Google Drive OAuth, video/AdMob reconciliation, separately registered Firebase client and preview backend gates are satisfied.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main current production-source baseline 7ebbbd504df2f84355888cc64a8c5317319d6d65 verified by connector on 2026-11-15; branch forked at Nov14 scoped staging OTA source SHA 2e7dc3aa69d2362b7b360013ccaac9917c353e2b. Published staging-user OTA run 43596652659; main release and real device acceptance not modified or inferred. Production runtime 1.3.2, package org.mzbministry.buklod. New Firebase org.mzbministry.buklod.nativeqa does not exist in repository registered-client list. PR #638 native Google Drive was held and PR #813 video/ad optimization is draft/unmerged.
chosenApproach: A distinct APP_VARIANT native-lab in existing dynamic Expo config, unique org.mzbministry.buklod.nativeqa Android package, 1.4.0-nativeqa.1 runtime, native-lab channel and new Firebase configuration file path; internal EAS APK profile and fail-closed CI gates. Keep all old profiles and output unchanged; no EAS build until real registration and native integration are proven. Scope changes limited to new release identity/preflight and tests.
selectionRationale: Separate installed app and runtime prevent side-by-side lab testing from replacing the existing staging app or consuming production/staging-user OTA updates. Use a new Firebase client rather than editing or mislabeling credentials. EAS shared project uses a private distinct update channel with no production promotion.
alternativeApproaches: Reuse org.mzbministry.buklod.staging with a new runtime: rejected because Android would replace the owner's existing staging installation.
Copy the existing staging Firebase client under a new package string: rejected because that is not a genuine registered native Firebase/OAuth identity.
Publish experimental native features as Expo OTA to runtime 1.3.2: rejected because Java/Kotlin IME and native OAuth capabilities cannot be delivered by JS-only update.
preserveBehaviors: Existing org.mzbministry.buklod staging-user and production package names, runtime 1.3.2, project identity and channels remain byte-identical.
Old staging app remains installed and continues to receive only staging-user OTA; new lab channel never publishes over it.
Production sign-in/notifications/AdMob credentials and Supabase finances, points, RLS, video/media, and uploads are not mutated.
The native-lab Firebase client must be truly registered for the exact new package; no fabrication or misuse of older registered package data.
Unfinished native GIF/Google Drive/AdMob integration stays explicitly blocked from issuing an installable QA artifact.
acceptanceChecks: Native QA package is org.mzbministry.buklod.nativeqa, distinct from production, staging and Classroom.
Native QA runtime is 1.4.0-nativeqa.1, distinct from existing runtime 1.3.2; independent channel is native-lab.
EAS native-lab profile yields internal Android APK and staging preview app data, not production or old staging channel.
Unregistered Firebase client, missing native bridge, missing Google Drive OAuth, unfrozen scroll/ad source or production Supabase all block before EAS credits.
After incorporation, exact SHA typecheck, Android Hermes export, EAS signed APK and downloaded APK package/SHA256 checks are required.
Physical Android install and real Google Drive/GIF/video/ad behavior remains unverified until separately performed.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Introduce a distinct QA-only native Expo APK identity and strictly gated EAS workflow without changing old staging or production release behavior.
preservedBehaviors: Production and existing staging EAS channels, package names, runtime versions, authorization rules, finance, and OTA manifests remain unchanged.
New Firebase package registration and native integration are prerequisites before any signed APK build.
